"""Fresh original JPL/SOFA fixed-clock control, with no FateBridge import."""
import ctypes as C
import gzip
import hashlib
from importlib.metadata import version
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from jplephem.spk import SPK
from scipy.optimize import brentq, minimize_scalar
from skyfield.api import load, load_file

assert not any(name.startswith('fatebridge') for name in sys.modules)
base=Path(__file__).parent
plan=json.loads((base/'de440-polar-observation-plan.json').read_text())
kernel_path=base/'original-de440.bsp'
download=json.loads((base/'de440-download.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(kernel_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==download['sha256']
kernel=SPK.open(kernel_path)
sky=load_file(str(kernel_path));ts=load.timescale(builtin=True)
sofa=C.CDLL(str(base/'libofficial_sofa.dylib'))
author=C.CDLL(str(base/'libauthor_swiss_2_10_03_contract.dylib'))
geometry=C.CDLL(str(base/'libde440_solar_reference_geometry.dylib'))
DP=C.POINTER(C.c_double)
sofa.iauDtdb.argtypes=[C.c_double]*6;sofa.iauDtdb.restype=C.c_double
sofa.iauAb.argtypes=[DP,DP,C.c_double,C.c_double,DP];sofa.iauAb.restype=None
geometry.fb_de440_receiver.argtypes=[C.c_double]*5+[DP]
geometry.fb_de440_receiver.restype=C.c_int
geometry.fb_de440_reduce_direction.argtypes=[C.c_double]*3+[C.c_int,DP,DP,DP]
geometry.fb_de440_reduce_direction.restype=C.c_int
author.swe_deltat_ex.argtypes=[C.c_double,C.c_int,C.c_char_p];author.swe_deltat_ex.restype=C.c_double
author.swe_set_ephe_path.argtypes=[C.c_char_p];author.swe_set_ephe_path(b'/Users/thomas/Desktop/FateBridge/ephe')
author.swe_calc.argtypes=[C.c_double,C.c_int,C.c_int,DP,C.c_char_p];author.swe_calc.restype=C.c_int
author.swe_refrac_extended.argtypes=[C.c_double]*5+[C.c_int,DP];author.swe_refrac_extended.restype=C.c_double
threshold=author.swe_refrac_extended(0.,0.,1013.25,0.,.0065,1,(C.c_double*4)())
AU_KM=149597870.7;LIGHT_AU_DAY=173.14463267424034


def apparent_sun(tt,receiver_position,receiver_velocity):
    """Fixed receiver, two-part native TDB source and one official aberration."""
    offset=tt-2451545.+sofa.iauDtdb(2451545.,tt-2451545.,0.,0.,0.,0.)/86400
    emb=np.asarray(kernel[0,3].compute_and_differentiate(2451545.,offset))
    earth=np.asarray(kernel[3,399].compute_and_differentiate(2451545.,offset))+emb
    reception=earth[0]/AU_KM+receiver_position
    velocity=earth[1]/AU_KM+receiver_velocity
    sun_now=kernel[0,10].compute(2451545.,offset)/AU_KM
    solar_distance=float(np.linalg.norm(sun_now-reception))
    delay=0.
    for iterations in range(12):
        emitted=kernel[0,10].compute(2451545.,offset-delay)/AU_KM
        ray=emitted-reception;distance=float(np.linalg.norm(ray))
        new_delay=distance/LIGHT_AU_DAY
        if new_delay==delay or abs(new_delay-delay)<1e-16:break
        delay=new_delay
    else:raise RuntimeError('JPL source light cone did not converge')
    direction=ray/distance;beta=velocity/LIGHT_AU_DAY;result=np.full(3,np.nan)
    sofa.iauAb(direction.ctypes.data_as(DP),beta.ctypes.data_as(DP),solar_distance,
               math.sqrt(1-float(beta@beta)),result.ctypes.data_as(DP))
    return result,offset,iterations+1


old=json.loads(gzip.decompress((base/'solar-event-polar-cluster-reference.json.gz').read_bytes()))
cases=json.loads((base/'solar-event-polar-cluster-cases.json').read_text())
controls=[]
for index,construction in enumerate(old['constructions']):
    if construction['source_flags']!=4:continue
    ut1=construction['critical_time_ut1'];tt=ut1+author.swe_deltat_ex(ut1,2,C.create_string_buffer(256))
    own,offset,iterations=apparent_sun(tt,np.zeros(3),np.zeros(3))
    other=sky['earth'].at(ts.tdb_jd(2451545.,offset)).observe(sky['sun']).apparent().position.au
    other=other/np.linalg.norm(other)
    error=math.atan2(float(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(own,other))),float(own@other))*180/math.pi*3600
    controls.append(dict(construction=index,tt=tt,tdb_days_from_j2000=offset,
                         reference_icrs=own.tolist(),skyfield_icrs=other.tolist(),
                         separation_arcseconds=error,light_cone_iterations=iterations))
rows=[];started=time.perf_counter()
for case,expected in zip(cases,old['rows'],strict=True):
    if case['source_flags']!=4:continue
    query=case['query_ut1'];horizon=threshold if case['definition'] else 0.;cache={}

    def at(delta):
        ut1=float(query+float(delta))
        if ut1 not in cache:
            tt=ut1+author.swe_deltat_ex(ut1,2,C.create_string_buffer(256))
            pv=np.full(34,np.nan)
            status=geometry.fb_de440_receiver(tt,ut1,case['longitude'],case['latitude'],0.,pv.ctypes.data_as(DP))
            assert status==0,(status,ut1,tt)
            position=pv[:3] if case['definition'] else np.zeros(3)
            velocity=pv[3:6] if case['definition'] else np.zeros(3)
            ray,offset,iterations=apparent_sun(tt,position,velocity)
            result=np.full(4,np.nan)
            status=geometry.fb_de440_reduce_direction(tt,case['longitude'],case['latitude'],case['definition'],
                                                     pv.ctypes.data_as(DP),ray.ctypes.data_as(DP),result.ctypes.data_as(DP))
            assert status==0,status
            cache[ut1]=(float(result[3]-horizon),tt,iterations)
        return cache[ut1][0]

    grid=[i/1440 for i in range(1561)];values=[at(x) for x in grid];extrema=[]
    for j in range(1,len(grid)-1):
        a,b,c=values[j-1:j+2]
        if b>a and b>=c:sign=-1
        elif b<a and b<=c:sign=1
        else:continue
        centre=grid[j]
        solved=minimize_scalar(lambda q:sign*at(centre+q),bounds=(grid[j-1]-centre,grid[j+1]-centre),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-12,'maxiter':150})
        assert solved.success
        point=centre+float(solved.x);grid.append(point)
        extrema.append(dict(ut1=float(query+point),kind='maximum' if sign<0 else 'minimum',residual_degrees=at(point)))
    grid=sorted(set(grid));events=[]
    for a,b in zip(grid,grid[1:]):
        fa,fb=at(a),at(b);rising,setting=fa<0<=fb,fa>0>=fb
        if not(rising or setting):continue
        root,info=brentq(at,a,b,xtol=5e-15,rtol=4*np.finfo(float).eps,maxiter=150,full_output=True)
        assert info.converged
        ut1=float(query+root)
        if events and abs(ut1-events[-1]['ut1'])*86400<.0001:continue
        events.append(dict(ut1=ut1,tt=cache[ut1][1],kind='rise' if rising else 'set',residual_degrees=at(root)))
    rows.append(dict(case=expected['case'],input=case,status='ok',actual_source='original_JPL_DE440',roots=events,
                     extrema=extrema,evaluations=len(cache),maximum_light_cone_iterations=max(v[2] for v in cache.values())))
    if len(rows)%16==0:print(json.dumps(dict(windows=len(rows),seconds=time.perf_counter()-started)),flush=True)
summary=dict(windows=len(rows),roots=sum(len(r['roots']) for r in rows),skyfield_controls=len(controls),
             maximum_skyfield_direction_difference_arcseconds=max(r['separation_arcseconds'] for r in controls),
             seconds=time.perf_counter()-started)
report=dict(plan=plan,production_imported=False,kernel_receipt='de440-download.json',kernel_sha256=download['sha256'],
            packages={name:version(name) for name in ['jplephem','skyfield','numpy','scipy']},
            summary=summary,geocentric_direction_controls=controls,rows=rows,
            provenance={name:hashlib.sha256((base/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in [
                'libofficial_sofa.dylib','libauthor_swiss_2_10_03_contract.dylib',
                'de440_solar_reference_geometry.c','libde440_solar_reference_geometry.dylib','generate_de440_polar_reference.py']},
            scope='Independent source/optical comparison at identical declared clocks and conventions. No observed EOP, atmospheric, continuous-domain or SOTA certificate.')
path=base/'de440-polar-observation-reference.json.gz'
path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(json.dumps(report,separators=(',',':')).encode(),mtime=0))
summary['reference_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(base/'de440-polar-observation-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
kernel.close();sky.close()
